At every level you learn something real, in more or less detail:
  • 💡 Did you know…? at the top of each screen (money, career, country, government, war, sports): a real fact with its source. Tap the fact to see another; tap the title to fold it.
  • 📖 Glossary (More): 42 terms by category, with search. In Easy and Medium they appear underlined on screens; in Realistic you turn them on in Settings.
  • ⚖️ Medium: every year, «Your year in numbers» with the cause of what happened to your net worth; in Finances, «🔎 Why» with how much you save.
  • 🎓 Realistic: also the year's inflation and what weighed most, your income against prices, taxes with the effective rate, the real return on your accounts and the real cost of your loans, and why the central bank moved its rate. In Finances, «🔎 Why» with the tax brackets and real rates.
  • 🌱 Easy: first-time cards also in government and war, and short 🎯 challenges with their achievement.
  • 📚 When you die: the key decisions of your life, the concepts you used (tap them to see their definition) and a tip for the next one.
Everything is turned on or off in Settings → 🎓 Learning.
Understanding where each figure comes from (how much each tax bracket takes, how fast prices rise, how much your money really earns) is what separates an informed decision from a bet.

In Realistic: taxes by bracket with your marginal and effective rate, prices and purchasing power since you started working, and the real rate of the policy rate, your accounts and your loans. In Medium: how much you save and how many months your savings last.
Short, concrete goals are easier to reach than a big, distant one: each step completed gives information and motivation for the next.

In Easy, the next challenge appears above the map (open an account, save a year of wages, diversify…). Completing it earns its achievement and a little happiness. They can be turned off in Settings → 🎓 Learning.
